title: Canonical supported-constant base-change square and exchange
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, and let $Z',Z,X',X$ be schemes in universe $u$. Use the ordinary fixed-$A$ module sheaves, inverse images $f_t^*$, direct images $f_{t,*}$, adjunctions, constants $A_{T,t}$, supported constants $P_{t,i}=i_{t,*}A_{Z,t}$ and scalar-preserving identifications $u_{t,f}:f_t^*A_{T,t}\cong A_{T',t}$ of [def-pur-supported-constant-exchange-maps], where $t=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$. Fix a chosen Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with top $g:Z'\to Z$, bottom $h:X'\to X$, left $i':Z'\to X'$ and right $i:Z\to X$. Define $\theta_t:i_t'^*h_t^*\xrightarrow{\sim}g_t^*i_t^*$ as the specified inverse-image square isomorphism, using the existing coherent site-square data [def-per-site-comparison-pullback-data]. Define the supported-constant exchange $\beta_t:h_t^*P_{t,i}\to P_{t,i'}$ as the adjunction transpose under $i_t'^*\dashv i'_{t,*}$ of
$$i_t'^*h_t^*i_{t,*}A_{Z,t}\xrightarrow{\theta_t}g_t^*i_t^*i_{t,*}A_{Z,t}\xrightarrow{g_t^*(\epsilon_i)}g_t^*A_{Z,t}\xrightarrow{u_{t,g}}A_{Z',t}.$$
On the etale site this is the existing ordinary direct-image base-change map evaluated at $A_{Z,\mathrm{et}}$, followed by $i'_{\mathrm{et},*}(u_{\mathrm{et},g})$. On the pro-etale site it is the displayed adjunction mate. The maps are defined for arbitrary vertical morphisms; their specialization to closed immersions is the closed exchange. No invertibility or normalization property is asserted.
